title: Synthetic skill audit example
coverage: Demonstration only; no real installation or usage logs inspected
summary: A missing helper merits repair; overlapping review workflows need contextual inspection.

findings.finding: The named helper is absent in this fictional package. Locate the intended dependency before changing the workflow.
A mandatory second review could catch omissions or repeat the first review. Task outcomes are needed to decide whether to retain the extra pass.

evidence.excerpt: Always perform a second review of the plan.

findings.preserve: Checks for missing dependencies and verification steps

fix_now.reason: Locate or restore the missing required helper before relying on this workflow

test_next.reason: Determine whether the second review catches additional material omissions
test_next.task: Review a supplied plan with known missing dependencies and verification steps
test_next.success_criteria: Identify the real omissions without inventing issues; compare current, simpler and baseline procedures

test_later.reason: Evaluate reporting behavior after its dependency is repaired
test_later.task: Produce a weekly report from a small ledger with known totals
test_later.success_criteria: Preserve every required total and the reporting format
test_later.prerequisite: The required helper has been restored and passes its own checks

keep.reason: Preserve its required totals and reporting format through any repair or simplification

limitations: Synthetic data; no performance claim or retirement recommendation
